en.bdb: End of the truth and falsehood

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜ ਦੁਇ ਝਾਗੜੂ ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਚਉਤੈ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach kooR dhui jhaagaRoo jhagaRaa karadhe chautai aaiaa|

en.bdb: Truth and falsehood had a tiff and quarrelling they came to the dias of justice.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਆਇ ਆਪ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਝਗੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: age sachaa sach niaai aap hajoor dhovai jhagaRaiaa|

en.bdb: Dispenser of the true justice made them to debate their points there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach sachaa kooR kooRiaar pa(n)chaa vichidho kar samajhaiaa|

en.bdb: The wise mediators concluded that the truth is true and the falsehood Her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਰਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach jitaa kooR haariaa kooR kooRaa kar sahar firaiaa|

en.bdb: The truth triumphed and the falsehood lost and being labeled untrue, was paraded in the whole city.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿਆਰੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੈ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sachiaarai saabaas hai kooRiaarai fiT fiT karaiaa|

en.bdb: The truthfull was applauded but the untrue incurred opprobrium.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਲਹਣਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਖਤੁ ਸਤਾਗਲੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach lahanaa kooR dhevanaa khat sataagal likh dhevaiaa|

en.bdb: This was written on a piece of paper that the truth is creditory and the falsehood debtor.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਠਗਾਇ ਨ ਠਗੀਐ ਠਗਣਹਾਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਠਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aap Thagai na Thageeaai Thaganahaarai aap Thagaiaa|

en.bdb: He who allows himself to be cheated is never deceived and he who cheats others gets himself cheated.
Any rare one is a buyer of truth.
